name: Königsheim (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically yellow and blue, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Königsheim (a crown above three apples on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Königsheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Königsheim arms — crown and apples on blue
